items.text: Lamar Jackson listed QUESTIONABLE (ankle/high ankle sprain). Status crucial for DFS main slate; heading in right direction per self but official Q.
items.why: ETR Sunday injury dump; Schefter/Rapoport confirm high ankle, Q listing, self says right direction.
items.implication: Monitor for ACTIVE/INACTIVE; backup implications if OUT.
items.opportunity: If OUT, Huntley or similar elevated; Ravens pass game volatility.

items.text: Puka Nacua QUESTIONABLE (calf). Took majority practice Thursday but felt lack of power/explosion; will test pregame. Minor per early reports.
items.why: ETR dump + McVay quotes via Rapoport/Schefter/Levitan; no full practice Friday.
items.implication: Game-time decision; hierarchy if OUT favors Higbee heavily.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Tyler Higbee #1 target funnel, then Mumpfield/Parkinson/Atwell.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad). Crucial DFS status; Berry would start if active vs MIA despite some worry.
items.why: ETR Sunday list; Levitan flags as key.
items.implication: If ACTIVE start per Berry; if OUT handcuff elevated.
items.opportunity: Full workload if cleared vs soft MIA run D.

items.text: Multiple high-profile OUTs: Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Jeremiyah Love, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Brian Robinson. Schefter full list corroborates.
items.why: ETR comprehensive dump + Schefter official OUTs photo list.
items.implication: Clear handcuff/backup elevations and target redistributions.
items.opportunity: Bijan full opp (BRob OUT); Kittle more; Jacobs clear; Seahawks RB next man; Colts TE next; etc.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel ruled OUT for 49ers vs Falcons. Shanahan/Rapoport coach confirm Evans (Achilles).
items.why: Official team ruling + Schefter list + Rapoport Shanahan quote.
items.implication: Massive WR funnel to Kittle; CMC slot temptation rises.
items.opportunity: George Kittle primary beneficiary; CMC more WR snaps possible.

items.text: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison (and Hockenson) listed IN. Jacobs was at facility for non-football activities earlier.
items.why: ETR IN section; Levitan prior facility note for Jacobs.
items.implication: Startable with full roles; reverse any prior backup hype.
items.opportunity: Jacobs clear lead; Judkins elevated CLE role; Addison MIN targets.

items.text: Saquon Barkley return: if active vs DAL, right back into lineups (Love). Efficient in two full games played this season.
items.why: Pregame with Stephania Bell agreement; matchup vs DAL.
items.implication: Must-start RB if cleared for MNF.

items.text: Breece Hall: if plays vs MIA, back in starting lineup (despite Bell worry). Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% TS, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec both games. Love Jaylen Warren game more and more.
items.why: Usage spike post-Caleb return for Loveland; Warren film; Breece matchup.
items.implication: Start all three if statuses clear.
items.opportunity: Loveland high TS with Williams; Warren featured; Breece volume.

items.text: If Puka Nacua can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen. Adams also OUT amplifies TE funnel.
items.why: McVay quotes on calf + historical TE target share when Puka out (37%).
items.implication: Higbee strong streamer/DFS pivot if Puka inactive.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike; Higbee primary.
corroboration: Berry 10 facts note on TE share

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT creates really sweet setup for Bijan Robinson vs SF. 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent games show high RB catch volume (White/Holani/Harvey/Love).
items.why: BRob official OUT + SF recent RB receptions data + DvP metric.
items.implication: Bijan full opportunity + pass-game upside vs soft DvP.
items.opportunity: Full snap/carry/target share; no BRob committee.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: awesome scheme + entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT). Rarely buy RB-as-WR but tempted by CMC slot comments given dire WR situation + Kaelon Black.
items.why: WR outs confirmed; CMC smile on slot question; National TE Day irrelevant historically.
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1 lock; CMC potential extra routes.
items.opportunity: Kittle target monopoly; CMC slot snaps if deployed.
items.conflict: Levitan rarely trusts RB WR alignments but this exception due to injuries.

items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet to IR, season-ending serious knee injury (carted Thursday). Coach Johnson confirm. Opens more for Burden/others.
items.implication: Permanent TE depth loss; WR/TE route redistribution.
items.opportunity: Burden more routes (less multi-TE); possible other TE up.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; Kmet IR (season-ending) may reduce 2/3-TE sets for more Burden juice. TreVeyon Henderson just 21% snaps last 3 weeks - not like this.
items.why: Route/YPRR data + Kmet IR confirm (Schefter/Rapoport); Henderson snap % video.
items.implication: Burden breakout potential; fade/sit Henderson until snaps rise.
items.opportunity: Burden route rate up post-Kmet; Henderson committee/low trust.

items.text: Loves: AJ Brown @CHI (usage bounceback), DeVonta Smith vs DAL, Matthew Golden @DET (deep targets vs soft Lions deep D), Tucker Kraft @DET (TE TDs allowed). Hates: Rome Odunze vs NE (Gonzalez shadow).
items.why: Target/route shares, matchup data (Lions deep/completion, Bears yards, Gonzalez shadow).
items.opportunity: Brown 33% TS bounce; Kraft TE boost; Golden deep volume.
